headline: Sample: one line of about 15 words with the single most important cross-market fact
subhead: One sentence of supporting detail under the headline, with the key numbers.

us.text: Short claim with the key numbers, for example the S&P 500 fell 0.5 percent to 7,624.
Second driver in one short sentence.
Third point, for example what the week ahead turns on.

india.text: Nifty and Bank Nifty close and the reason.
FII and DII net flows in crore rupees.

global.text: One notable cross-asset move: dollar, yields, oil or crypto.

aapl.outlook_1y: Analyst consensus target 245 (32 analysts, Yahoo). Sell-side range 190 to 300.
aapl.outlook_lt: Long-run case rests on services mix shift; bears cite China and AI capex lag. No number is reliable beyond 12 months.

gold.outlook_1y: Goldman Sachs 12m forecast 4,300 (Sep 2026 note); UBS 4,100. Drivers: central bank buying, real yields.
gold.outlook_lt: Structural demand from EM central banks; downside if real yields rise. Cite the house, never invent.

ipos.name: Example Ltd
ipos.subscription: 2.4x overall at day 2 close (QIB 1.1x, NII 3.0x, retail 2.9x)

weekly.narrative: Saturday only. Three to five sentences on what drove the week across US, India, metals and crypto, and the setup for next week. Winners and losers are computed on the page from 1W returns; do not list them here.

_schema_note: Keys: date, generated_at, headline (one line, about 15 words), subhead (one sentence), summary{us,india,global} each an array of 3 {text, source, url}, calendar[{when,what}] (separate items within a day with '; '), assets{id:{outlook_1y,outlook_lt,news[{title,source,url,date}]}}, ipos[{name,market,sector,open,close,price_band,lot,size,subscription,gmp,gmp_url,source,source_url,drhp_url}] (subscription, gmp, gmp_url are empty strings when not sourced), weekly{week_ending,narrative} (Saturdays only, otherwise omit or leave unchanged). Older briefs with a long headline and string summaries still render.
